scope: Full book editions, compiled drafts, legacy whole-book imports, editable packages, full-book PDF render variants. Chapter-only drafts, source research PDFs, motif-only proofs, raster proof screenshots and website downloads unrelated to the book are excluded. No builds or uploads performed.
deduplication: One artifact entry per SHA256. All matching files were individually hashed. Version and kind from explicit filename or nearest versioned parent; legacy draft labels retained without assigning semantic versions. preferred_source_path prioritizes finalized deliverable manifests, then edition owner worktree and compiled book location. Generic bonus-package book names are assigned to the version of an explicitly named artifact only when their full SHA256 matches.
negative_controls: Planted all-zero SHA256 rejected by actual deliverable hash comparison.

archive_findings.sts_edition_archive: Only v0.8.0, v0.8.1 and v0.8.2 directory copies. Byte-identical originals deduplicated by actual SHA256; distinct full-book proof renders preserved as variants. No independent archive workflow or manifest found there.
archive_findings.archive_v1: No filesystem archive-v1 directory found. Local archive/v1-original-site branch has no rendered book PDF, EPUB or ZIP.
archive_findings.delivery_workflow: v0.10.0 through v0.11.0 docs/vVERSION/deliverables.json records six final deliveries each. publication/package*/package-manifest.json records editable package members. No existing GitHub release upload workflow found in inspected roots.
archive_findings.version_0_9_3: Source worktree and Git book-v0.9.3 branch exist, but no versioned book PDF/EPUB or compiled whole-book Markdown found in scoped roots.
